استخرجوا (form X)
# اِسْتَخْرَجُوا (istaḵrajū) /is.tax.ra.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اُسْتُخْرِجُوا (ustuḵrijū) /us.tux.ri.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اِسْتَخْرِجُوا (istaḵrijū) /is.tax.ri.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
